theorems.name: Submission.frt_hausdorff_null_of_weight_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (U Z : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → Z ⊆ U → μ Z = 0 → (∀ x ∈ Z, 0 < limsup (densityRatio n μ x) (𝓝[>] 0)) → μHE[n] Z = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
